title: Near a point of one open line piece away from the closures of the others, a union of pieces is locally the line (parent step 3e)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, ι a finite type, p, v : ι → ℝ^P, I : ι → Set ℝ, M ⊆ ℝ^P, k ∈ ι and x ∈ ℝ^P. Put S_j := {p_j + t·v_j : t ∈ I_j}. Assume ‖v_k‖ = 1, I_k is open, M ⊆ ⋃_j S_j, S_k ⊆ M, x ∈ S_k, and x ∉ closure(S_j) for every j ≠ k. Then there is r > 0 such that M ∩ B_r(x) = {y : y − x ∈ span{v_k}} ∩ B_r(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ι : Type) [Finite ι] (p v : ι → Euclid P) (I : ι → Set ℝ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (k : ι) (x : Euclid P), ‖v k‖ = 1 → IsOpen (I k) → M ⊆ (⋃ j, (fun t : ℝ => p j + t • v j) '' I j) → (fun t : ℝ => p k + t • v k) '' I k ⊆ M → x ∈ (fun t : ℝ => p k + t • v k) '' I k → (∀ j, j ≠ k → x ∉ closure ((fun t : ℝ => p j + t • v j) '' I j)) → ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ M ∩ ball x r = {y | y - x ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {v k}} ∩ ball x r
